content.text: Before we get too excited, let me apply some mental models and identify what could go wrong here.
What are the risks of this investment?

Let me invert this. What would cause this to fail? I see three major risks: 1) Incentive misalignment - the team's tokens vest too quickly, 2) Competitive moat is weaker than it appears - low switching costs, 3) Regulatory risk is underpriced - this looks like an unregistered security. The base rate for projects like this is 90% failure. I'm voting NO unless we get significant price concession.

all: Identify what could go wrong first
Apply mental models from multiple disciplines
